text:
Using Faux Brick As a Chimney Facade

Chimneys serve an important purpose: allowing smoke and gases from a fireplace to safely exhaust from the home.

For centuries, brick has been the go-to construction material of choice for chimneys. This has been the most obvious option, as brick can withstand high levels of heat, it’s very strong, and brick materials are widely available.

However, while the inside of a chimney is well-served with the use of real brick, there’s no need for the outside of the chimney to be constructed using real brick. In fact, installing a faux brick chimney facade has numerous benefits.

Let’s explore the many advantages that come with opting for a faux brick facade as a solution for chimney exteriors.

Better Aesthetic, Lower Maintenance

The number one reason our customers tell us they love GenStone for chimney facades is the look . Our faux brick panels are manufactured using molds made from real brick. And, every single panel is hand-painted using colors inspired by real brick installations. This translates into a finished product that is visually indistinguishable from real brick.

What’s more, we now offers custom coloring options for our faux brick and faux stone products. This has huge implications for homeowners! Now, if you want to use a faux brick veneer that goes well with the color theme of your home, you can.

Or, you can always choose from our line-up of pre-colored faux brick products, including:

- Chicago Brick

- Classic Brick

- Deep Red Brick

- Multi-Colored Brick

Multi Color Brick Panels

Not sure which faux brick chimney veneer will look the best on your home? We have a solution for that!

Our team of designers will create a graphical mock-up using an image you provide us. So, grab your camera, snap a photo of your chimney, and send it to us. We’ll do some graphic design wizardry and provide you with a visual estimation of what any of our faux brick panels would look like on your home.

It couldn’t be easier!

And, speaking of easy…maintaining a faux brick chimney facade is about as easy as it gets. That is to say, you don’t have to worry about pressure washing the chimney, remortaring it, or having to replace panels due to weathering or wearing.

GenStone faux brick panels are constructed using a high-density polyurethane foam that is lightweight, exceptionally strong, and resilient enough to last for decades of outdoor exposure to the elements. The same can’t be said for real brick!

Faux Brick Chimney Facade Installation

If you’re not totally sold on the idea of using GenStone faux brick panels to create a chimney facade, this last fact will seal the deal for you: installation is a breeze . It’s actually something you can do yourself, without having to hire a mason or contractor.

As long as you can safely access your chimney and you have a few basic hand tools, you could complete a faux brick chimney facade installation in a single afternoon.

Here are the required steps:

- Measure the surface area of your chimney exterior. This will give you an idea of how many panels to order. For tips on taking accurate measurements, view our ‘How to Measure’ guide .

- Choose the GenStone faux brick style that suits your home. Refer to the options listed above, or get in touch with us to start the custom coloring process.

- Place your order for panels, ledgers, trim, and corner pieces. You can buy GenStone from your local, participating hardware store.

Not sure which panels to buy, or how many of each you need? Just ask us; we’ll be happy to help!

- Cut your faux brick panels to size. Every GenStone faux brick panel can be cut-to-size using a handsaw, radial saw, or circular saw.

- Affix the panels using pre-drilled holes and industrial adhesive. Don’t forget to visit our ‘How to Install’ page for more faux brick panel installation tips and tricks.

- Enjoy the new look of your faux stone chimney facade!

At GenStone, our goal is to make it as easy as possible to buy and install faux brick and faux stone panels for a variety of applications. When it comes to resurfacing a chimney, our faux brick products are second-to-none in their quality, durability, and ease of installation.

After you’ve completed your faux brick chimney facade project, don’t forget to take a picture and send it to us, so we can include it on our ‘Projects’ page .

Good luck from your friends at GenStone!
